rationale: No supported optimization is safely applicable. Dependency downloading is already cached via pnpm/action-setup@v6 with cache: true in every job, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already satisfied; adding another cache would be redundant, and the pattern explicitly advises caching dependency state rather than unchecked build outputs. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is not applicable because the repository CI history is explicitly not a measured baseline and there is no representative per-job successful-duration history; the check job installs Playwright Chromium with system dependencies on cold runners, so an arbitrary timeout risks false timeouts on valid slow runs, which is the pattern's stated contraindication and would reduce test coverage. The remaining patterns either lack a matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), are ci_service rather than workflow changes (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE, P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE), or rely on synthetic evidence with unverified contraindications (P-LIT-UNUSED-DEP-SKIP, P-LIT-UNUSED-OUTPUTS). Build and test coverage is preserved as-is.
